portal.title: TraceForge
portal.subtitle: Development Asset Management + AI Traceable Collaboration Platform
portal.hero_desc: Structuring requirements, specs, decisions, and evidence from the development process into traceable assets. AI collaborates with developers throughout — observable processes, auditable decisions, reusable experience.
portal.auth_subtitle: Development Asset Management · AI Traceable Collaboration

highlights.asset_desc: Structuring development artifacts — requirements, spec documents, task decisions, human-AI deltas, and runtime evidence — into managed assets. Supports hierarchical requirement splitting, full-chain traceability matrix, and automatic knowledge distillation.
highlights.traceable_desc: Real-time AI collaboration with full observability into thinking process, token attribution, and cost. Human-in-the-loop (HITL) controls critical decisions, human-AI delta analysis attributes every change, and task closeout automatically generates evidence chains and process audits. AI doesn't replace developers — it advances together with them.

features.automation_desc: From requirement clarification to code delivery, AI and developers collaborate throughout.
features.spec_driven_desc: Document workbench, block-level review, version switching — specs come first.
features.api_mock_desc: Swagger import, mock case management, AI auto-generation, real-time collaboration.
features.safety_desc: Human intervention at critical decision points, HITL ensures safe high-risk operations.
features.asset_mgmt_desc: Requirement repository, task asset table, evidence registry, knowledge distillation.
features.traceability_desc: Coverage matrix, human-AI delta dashboard, risk aggregation, process audit.

portal.core_drivers_desc: Six core capabilities covering the full development lifecycle
portal.footer_tagline: Crafted by Deepmind Advanced Agentic Coding Lab

create.step_preview: Review editable Preview items before writing real Requirements.

steps.manual: Write one Requirement or paste requirement text.

methods.manual_body: Write one item or paste text for AI Preview.
methods.source_link_body: Record an external PRD, Issue, or Ticket reference.

create.manual_step_body: Fill in a Requirement directly, or paste requirement text into the description and generate an AI Preview from it.
create.file_step_body: The file content can be written as one Requirement or sent to AI Preview. External source references are recorded in a separate method.
create.source_link_body: Use this method for external PRD, Issue, Ticket, or document links. It records the source reference without fetching remote content.
create.source_link_boundary: This records a real source reference only. It does not import remote content, create Task records, or mark Coverage Verified.
create.coverage_boundary: Requirement status is a demand-asset state. Coverage Verified still requires real Evidence and human confirmation.
create.ai_preview_boundary: AI Preview only creates editable preview items and future Task prompts. It does not create Tasks, Evidence, Coverage, or code commits.

preview.title: Preview Items
preview.body: Preview records are not real Requirements until applied and confirmed.
preview.empty: No Preview has been generated yet. You can import as one Requirement or generate an AI Preview.
preview.split_empty: Waiting for real AI Preview. Paragraph splitting is not used to fabricate split results.

preview_progress.title: Generating AI Preview
preview_progress.body: Claude Code CLI is running in the configured workspace directory. This may take a moment.
preview_progress.split_body: Claude Code CLI is checking whether this Requirement should become child Requirements.
preview_progress.boundary: AI Preview is only a draft preview. It does not create Tasks, Evidence, Coverage, Verified states, or code commits.

edit.boundary: Requirement status is an editable demand-asset state. Coverage Verified is still derived from real Evidence and human confirmation.

detail.no_body: No body has been written for this Requirement yet.
detail.specification_body: Body content is formatted into paragraphs, lists, and headings for easier review.
detail.children_specification_body: This Requirement has been split into child Requirements. Specification content is shown through the child list to avoid repeating the parent source body.
detail.criteria_body: Editable Requirement fields only. Coverage remains a derived Traceability result.
detail.no_criteria: No acceptance criteria have been recorded yet.
detail.related_tasks_body: Requirement can link to one or more Tasks. Task Detail carries Spec, Plan, AI Runs, Review, Delta and Evidence.
detail.audit_body: Real create, edit, import, split and Task-link actions are recorded here.
detail.no_audit: No audit records are available for this Requirement yet.
detail.empty_body: The detail area shows source reference, acceptance criteria, related Tasks and audit history from real records.

traceability.coverage_body: Reserved aggregate view. Coverage Status cannot be generated from fake data, and Verified requires real Evidence plus human confirmation.
traceability.evidence_body: Reserved evidence registry index. Later it should only accept sources traceable to real commits, MRs, diffs, files, reports, logs, or human confirmations.
traceability.delta_body: Reserved human delta analysis view. It expresses differences between AI output and final human changes without assuming the platform owns final code or auto-commits it.
traceability.risk_body: Reserved risk aggregate entry. Later data should come from real tasks, reviews, evidence, and human decisions.
traceability.drilldown_body: After real data is connected, aggregate views can drill down to Requirement or Task. This phase only reserves structure and does not write original assets.

matrix.title: Spec Coverage Matrix
matrix.body: The matrix is derived from Requirement, Task, Spec, Plan, AI Run, Human Review, Human Delta, Evidence, Decision, and Clarification records. It is not a manually maintained asset.
matrix.guardrail: Verified requires real Evidence plus human confirmation. Evidence Missing, Spec Covered, and In Progress are not completion states.

status_detail.missing: No real Requirement-to-Task process asset path exists yet.
status_detail.spec_covered: A real Spec exists, but this does not mean coverage is verified or closed.
status_detail.in_progress: Process records exist, but evidence and human confirmation conditions are not met.
status_detail.human_modified: A traceable Human Delta exists and represents final human changes.
status_detail.evidence_missing: Process records exist, but no real Evidence source is attached.
status_detail.need_clarification: An open Clarification exists and must be resolved first.
status_detail.rejected: A Human Review or Decision carries an explicit rejection signal.
status_detail.verified: Shown only when real Evidence and human confirmation both exist.

matrix.empty_body: Waiting for real Requirement and Task links. This view does not fabricate Covered, Verified, or Evidence Complete states.

knowledge.types_body: Knowledge Base is not a generic document library. It receives long-term assets promoted from real Task process records.
knowledge.business_body: Reserved business concept category, waiting for real Workspace knowledge assets.
knowledge.api_body: Reserved API usage card category. Later records should come from real implementation and human confirmation.
knowledge.framework_body: Reserved framework pattern category for reusable development patterns.
knowledge.constraint_body: Reserved constraint rule category. Later it should link to real requirements, decisions, and evidence sources.
knowledge.adr_body: Reserved reusable ADR category for long-term architecture decision memory.
knowledge.promotion_body: Later, knowledge assets can be promoted from real Task Decisions, Human Delta, Clarifications, and Review Comments.

promotion.waiting: Waiting for real source and human confirmation

overview.no_requirements: Waiting for real Requirement links. This area does not fabricate coverage relationships.
overview.process_assets_body: Spec, Plan, AI Run, Human Review, Human Delta, Evidence, Coverage, and Risk come from real process records or pending connection states.

backfill_dialog.title: Backfill Decision

clarifications.description: Records unclear requirements, business semantics, or framework API questions and distinguishes blocking from non-blocking issues.
clarifications.boundary: Open blocking clarifications cannot support Verified.
clarifications.empty: Waiting for AI or humans to raise real clarification questions. The page does not invent answers when information is missing.

final_summary.title: Final closure summary
final_summary.description: Records final status, remaining risks, final Evidence, human confirmation, and next suggestions.
final_summary.boundary: Saving VERIFIED must pass backend rules: Coverage Verified, accepting Human Review, and no open blocking Clarification.
final_summary.empty: Waiting for real Review, Evidence, Delta, and human confirmation before forming a final conclusion.

audit.title: Process asset audit
audit.description: Shows real write records for this Task Detail.
audit.empty: No process asset audit entries yet.

spec.title: Spec structured area
spec.description: Carries requirement understanding, boundary conditions, acceptance criteria, and open questions. Empty slots are shown when no real content exists.
spec.empty: This Task has no real Spec connected yet. The page will not auto-generate requirement understanding or acceptance criteria from the task name.

plan.title: Plan structured area
plan.description: Carries implementation steps, affected modules, risks, and verification method. Real Plan and Plan Nodes are shown first.
plan.empty: This Task has no real Plan connected yet. The page will not fabricate steps, risks, or verification methods.

ai_runs.title: AI Runs execution records
ai_runs.description: Carries AI execution records, input summary, output summary, status, and adoption status. Adoption status defaults to unavailable.
ai_runs.empty: This Task has no real AI Run connected yet. The page will not fabricate AI output or adoption conclusions.

human_review.title: Human Review records
human_review.description: Carries human review conclusions, review comments, and whether changes are needed.
human_review.empty: This Task has no real Human Review connected yet. The page will not fabricate human review conclusions.

human_delta.title: Human Delta
human_delta.description: Carries differences between AI output and final human changes, including reason, type, and external references, without assuming the platform owns final code.
human_delta.empty: This Task has no real Human Delta connected yet. The page will not auto-analyze or invent human change reasons.

evidence.title: Evidence references
evidence.description: Carries code, test, review, runtime, and external-system evidence. Only real sources are shown.
evidence.empty: This Task has no real Evidence connected yet. Without real sources, no evidence chain or Verified state is shown.

decisions.title: Human Decisions
decisions.description: Carries human decisions produced in this Task and their basis.
decisions.empty: This Task has no real Decision connected yet. The page will not fabricate technical or product decisions.

clarifications.title: Clarifications
clarifications.description: Carries unclear requirement, business meaning, framework API, and similar questions with answers.
clarifications.empty: This Task has no real Clarification connected yet. The page will not fabricate questions or answers.

final.title: Final Summary
final.description: Carries closure status, remaining risks, and next suggestions. This phase only shows pending or unavailable states.
final.pending_next_steps: Wait for real Evidence, Human Review, Human Delta, and human confirmation before forming suggestions.
final.boundary: Final Summary does not auto-generate closure conclusions. Verified requires real Evidence and human confirmation.
